note: NOT a bit-exact/tolerance fixture like the rest of this port -- compared via Adjusted Rand Index, see PCA_VALIDATION.md. Data is synthetic cosine-friendly blobs (see make_cosine_friendly_blobs in the generator script): 6 clusters x 30 points, 24 features, cluster centers on scaled orthogonal axes, noise_scale=0.8, seed=7. Labels are evoc.EVoC(random_state=7).fit_predict(X) with the library's own defaults (n_neighbors=15, n_epochs=50, base_min_cluster_size=5, min_samples=5, noise_level=0.5).
